label: Default Model
description: Used for new chats unless you pick a different model in the composer.

label: Fallback Models
description: Backup provider:model entries to try if the default model fails.

label: Max Agent Steps
description: Upper bound for tool-calling turns before KronOS stops a run.

label: Service Tier
description: Fast mode: fast = always, auto = first N seconds of each turn, cold = first turn only

label: Image Attachments
description: Controls how image attachments are sent to the model.

label: Execution Backend
description: Terminal execution backend

label: Modal mode
description: Modal sandbox mode

label: Working Directory
description: Default project folder for tool and terminal work.

label: Environment Passthrough
description: Environment variables to pass into tool execution.

label: Docker Image
description: Container image used when the execution backend is Docker.

label: Singularity Image
description: Image used when the execution backend is Singularity.

label: Modal Image
description: Image used when the execution backend is Modal.

label: Daytona Image
description: Image used when the execution backend is Daytona.

label: Vercel runtime
description: Legacy Vercel Sandbox runtime (deprecated by Vercel; a pinned runtime overrides the image; clear to use the image)

label: Persistent Shell
description: Keep shell state between commands when the backend supports it.

label: File Checkpoints
description: Create rollback snapshots before file edits.

label: File Read Limit
description: Maximum characters Hermes can read from one file request.

label: Auto-Compression
description: Summarize older context when conversations get large.

label: Personality
description: Default assistant style for new sessions.

label: Resume display
description: How resumed sessions display history

label: Busy input mode
description: Input behavior while agent is running

label: Reasoning Blocks
description: Show reasoning sections when the backend provides them.

label: Skin
description: CLI visual theme

label: Theme
description: Web dashboard visual theme

label: Text-To-Speech Provider
description: Text-to-speech provider

label: xAI (Grok) Voice
description: xAI voice ID (e.g. eve) or a custom voice ID.

label: xAI Language
description: Spoken language code (e.g. en, pt-BR) or "auto" for auto-detection.

label: xAI Playback Speed
description: Playback speed. 0.7 = slower, 1.0 = normal, 1.5 = faster.

label: xAI Auto Speech Tags
description: Let an LLM insert expressive audio tags ([laughing], [sighs]) into the script before synthesis.

label: xAI Streaming Latency Optimization
description: Latency vs. quality trade-off. 0 = best quality, 2 = lowest latency.

label: xAI Sample Rate
description: Audio sample rate in Hz. Higher = better quality, larger files.

label: xAI Bit Rate
description: MP3 bitrate in bps. Only applies when codec is mp3.

label: NeuTTS Device
description: Local inference device for NeuTTS.

label: Speech To Text
description: Enable local or provider-backed speech transcription.

label: Echo Transcripts
description: Post the raw 🎙️ transcript of voice messages back to the chat.

label: Streaming model
description: OpenAI live transcription model (stt.streaming)

label: ElevenLabs Language
description: Optional ISO-639-3 language code. Blank lets ElevenLabs auto-detect.

label: Read Responses Aloud
description: Automatically speak assistant responses.

label: Provider
description: Wake engine. Auto selects a platform-supported engine; Porcupine requires PORCUPINE_ACCESS_KEY.

label: Mode
description: Simulated typing delay mode

label: Context Engine
description: Context management engine

label: Persistent Memory
description: Save durable memories that can help future sessions.

label: User Profile
description: Maintain a compact profile of user preferences.

label: Subagent Reasoning Effort
description: Reasoning effort for delegated subagents

label: Timezone
description: IANA timezone identifier. Blank uses the system timezone.

label: Websocket heartbeat ack max age seconds
Approval Mode
description: Dangerous command approval mode

label: Approval Timeout
description: How long approval prompts wait before timing out.

label: Redact Secrets
description: Hide detected secrets from model-visible content when possible.

label: Code Execution Mode
description: How strictly code execution is scoped to the current project.

label: Level
description: Log level for agent.log

label: In-App Update Local Changes
description: When the chat app / gateway updates Hermes (no terminal prompt), what to do with uncommitted local source edits. 'stash' keeps them and re-applies them after the update; 'discard' throws them away. Terminal updates always ask, regardless of this setting.

label: Credential source
description: Where iron-proxy loads real upstream secrets at start time

label: Automatic Repository Discovery
description: Scan local folders for Git repositories to show in Projects.

label: Repository Discovery Roots
description: Folders to scan. Leave empty to scan your home directory.

label: Excluded Repository Paths
description: Folders and their descendants to skip during repository discovery.

label: Context window
description: 0 uses model metadata.
